alt.assets/og/features/online-courses.jpg: Online courses on Gradify: Gradify has free online courses on every one of its subject sites, from GCSE core and primary to medicine, law and physics.
alt.assets/og/features/explainer-videos.jpg: Explainer videos on Gradify: Gradify turns any lesson, unit or your own notes into a short narrated explainer video, one scene per section.
alt.assets/og/features/tutorials-and-simulat: Tutorials and simulations on Gradify: Gradify's courses include interactive tutorials and simulations you control, from a beating heart and protein structures to circuits and markets.
alt.assets/og/features/chant-podcasts.jpg: Chant podcasts on Gradify: Chant podcasts turn every unit of a Gradify course into an episode of short, repeated chants of its key facts, played back to back.
alt.assets/og/features/audio-questions.jpg: Audio questions on Gradify: Audio questions reads a question aloud, pauses so you can answer out loud, then reads the answer.
alt.assets/og/features/story-posters.jpg: Story posters on Gradify: Story posters tell a topic as a picture story, one panel at a time.
alt.assets/og/features/dictionaries-and-thes: Dictionaries and thesauruses on Gradify: Gradify's subject dictionaries define every key term used in its lessons, organised by subject.
alt.assets/og/features/key-terms-sheets.jpg: Key-terms sheets on Gradify: Key-terms sheets give you a printable sheet of every key term in a lesson, with or without the definitions.
alt.assets/og/features/bonus-facts-and-boost: Bonus facts and boosting on Gradify: As you revise in the flashcard feed, bonus facts appear between your cards, and any card you miss can be boosted so you see it more often.
3D visuals on demand on Gradify: Visualise lets you ask to see a concept, such as benzene, an electric field or the heart, and shows the best visual Gradify already has: a 3D molecule
alt.assets/og/features/notes-studio.jpg: Notes Studio on Gradify: Notes Studio turns a PDF of your notes, or notes you paste in, into flashcards, a mind map and a cheat sheet.
alt.assets/og/features/notebook.jpg: Notebook on Gradify: Gradify's Notebook keeps your notes as linked pages, like RemNote or Notion, and any line can become a flashcard.
alt.assets/og/features/handwriting-to-text.j: Handwriting to text on Gradify: Handwriting to text turns writing on a phone or tablet, or a photo of a handwritten page, into searchable text.
alt.assets/og/features/notes-to-songs.jpg: Notes to songs on Gradify: Paste notes in any format and Gradify turns them into a chant to say or sing along to, as well as flashcards, a mind map and a cheat sheet.
alt.assets/og/features/youtube-to-notes.jpg: YouTube to notes on Gradify: Paste a YouTube link and Gradify makes notes in chapters, flashcards and a mind map from the video, plus a chat that answers only from what's said in it.
alt.assets/og/features/spidermaps.jpg: Spidermaps on Gradify: Gradify's mind map creator builds a spidermap from facts you pick from any lesson, which you can then move, rename and add your own ideas to.
alt.assets/og/features/downloadable-resource: Downloadable resources on Gradify: Every lesson's resources can be downloaded and printed: notes, key-terms sheets, questions, posters, and flashcards ready to import into Anki.
alt.assets/og/features/flashcard-feed.jpg: Flashcard feed on Gradify: The flashcard feed is an endless scroll of flashcards from your decks and the subjects you choose, with bonus facts and study hacks mixed in.
alt.assets/og/features/confidence-ratings.jp: Confidence ratings on Gradify: After each flashcard you rate how well you knew it, and Gradify's spaced repetition (FSRS) brings the card back just before you'd forget it, paced to your exam date.
alt.assets/og/features/adaptive-difficulty.j: Adaptive difficulty on Gradify: Adaptive quizzes get harder or easier as you answer: two right in a row and the questions step up, one wrong and they step down.
alt.assets/og/features/timed-quiz-mode.jpg: Timed quiz mode on Gradify: Timed quiz mode gives you a quiz from any lesson, unit or deck with a fixed time to answer, so you practise against the clock like the real exam.
alt.assets/og/features/question-bank.jpg: Question bank on Gradify: The question bank puts every practice question on Gradify in one place, with marked feedback on every answer.
alt.assets/og/features/key-term-games.jpg: Key-term games on Gradify: Key-term games turn the vocabulary of any lesson, unit or your own flashcard deck into three quick games: Match, Speed round and Missing letters.
alt.assets/og/features/interim-quizzes.jpg: Interim quizzes on Gradify: Every Gradify course has short quizzes along the way, at the end of each unit, so you know where you stand before you move on.
alt.assets/og/features/gradify-tree.jpg: Gradify Tree on Gradify: The Gradify Tree grows as you learn, with a branch for every subject you study, so you can see your progress at a glance.
alt.assets/og/features/heatmap.jpg: Heatmap on Gradify: The heatmap shows every day you've learned across every Gradify site, in one calendar grid, so gaps and streaks are easy to see.
alt.assets/og/features/xp-and-levels.jpg: XP and levels on Gradify: You earn XP for what you learn on Gradify and level up as it adds up.
alt.assets/og/features/streaks.jpg: Streaks on Gradify: Gradify counts two kinds of streak: a daily streak for every day in a row you learn something, and a streak of correct answers in a row.
alt.assets/og/features/challenges.jpg: Challenges on Gradify: Gradify sets daily and weekly challenges across your sites, such as a number of questions or lessons, for XP and rewards.
alt.assets/og/features/reward-scheme.jpg: Reward scheme on Gradify: Gradify rewards long-term milestones, such as answering 1,000 questions or keeping a 100-day streak, and each one is earned once and kept.
alt.assets/og/features/projects-for-xp.jpg: Projects for XP on Gradify: Projects for XP are real projects to complete step by step, such as teaching a topic in a 3-minute video.
alt.assets/og/features/smart-reminders.jpg: Smart reminders on Gradify: Smart reminders know your deadlines and your streak, and remind you when it's time to revise.
alt.assets/og/features/time-blocking.jpg: Time blocking on Gradify: Plan your week in time blocks on a calendar, and let Gradify auto-plan your revision into your free time from your goals, fading topics and deadlines.
alt.assets/og/features/gradify-ai.jpg: Gradify AI on Gradify: Gradify AI will be an AI chat in the corner of every page that knows your progress on every Gradify site.
alt.assets/og/features/tutors.jpg: Tutors on Gradify: In Gradify's community, learners offer to tutor in subjects they know well, and you can ask one for help inside Gradify.
alt.assets/og/features/student-mentors.jpg: Student mentors on Gradify: Student mentors are students a year or two ahead of you who offer advice, on subjects, applications and what comes next, inside Gradify.
alt.assets/og/features/study-groups.jpg: Study groups on Gradify: Gradify study groups are private groups with a join code, a chat, members and a weekly leaderboard, for revising together online.
alt.assets/og/features/friends-and-school-le: Friends and school leaderboards on Gradify: Follow your friends with their friend code and compare progress on friends' and school leaderboards in Gradify.
alt.assets/og/features/community-chats.jpg: Community chats on Gradify: Gradify has a chat for every subject and site, where learners can ask and answer each other's questions about what they're studying.
alt.assets/og/features/internshipgradify.jpg: InternshipGradify on Gradify: InternshipGradify lists well-known internship, placement and work experience schemes in the UK, matched to the subjects you study.
